about_short_description.short_description: AI Rudder is an AI startup that develops AI-powered voice solutions to improve B2C communications.

product.name: AI Voice Agent
product.description: An enterprise voice AI solution for automated inbound and outbound calls, using natural-sounding conversations to handle customer service, collections, verification, telemarketing, and follow-up workflows.

product.name: AI Chat Agent
product.description: A conversational AI solution that automates customer interactions across digital messaging channels, providing context-aware responses for service, collections, engagement, and transactional workflows.

product.name: AI Contact Center
product.description: An AI-enabled contact-center platform combining interaction automation, analytics, and real-time assistance to improve customer service and agent operations.

product.name: BotLab
product.description: A low-code platform for designing, deploying, monitoring, and optimizing enterprise AI agents, with tools for conversation workflows, lifecycle management, and performance analytics.

product.name: Omnichannel
product.description: A customer-communication solution that connects voice, chat, email, and social channels so organizations can manage interactions through coordinated, consistent workflows.
